case: F7 unchanged geometry + TL/BrittleHistory + finite mass-weighted centroid RATTLE

geometry.process_version: Independent v4 supported placement, split-guide release/stow, real subsequent dry feeding
geometry.initial_geometry: separate straight cords; no finished weave or initial crimp
geometry.topology_pattern: periodic centreline used only for discrete over/under commands and feed reserve
geometry.qualification: Source-only geometry; actual dynamic contact/order and time-step checks pending
geometry.guide_idealization: Frictionless floating rolling-bearing cross-section-centroid y constraints; x/z and cross-sectional deformation free, reaction applied by mass-metric grid projection. Normal latch opens at release; split halves retract0.225mm in0.15ms then stow1.5mm normally in0.8ms before feed. Not a resolved solid-machine contact model.

plan.scope: Ideal flexible circular cords, finite machine-end commands; no friction, resin, industrial rate or strength calibration
plan.admission: Actual resource pilot required; analytic storage is not peak memory
validation_required: no unsupported end or same-family contact
small local Hertz footprint and connected extent
dt and discretization sensitivity before physical performance claims
plan.qualification: Fresh dynamic batch process; CFL.24 is unqualified until equal-time actual diagnostic, no full-process convergence claim

guide_projection: position and velocity; mass metric; only centroid y; x/z unconstrained

constraint_work_definition.position_multiplier: lambda_x has kg*m; correction is M^-1 G^T lambda_x; half-step constraint impulse is G^T lambda_x/dt
constraint_work_definition.velocity_multiplier: lambda_v has kg*m/s and is the velocity projection impulse
constraint_work_definition.velocity_actual_jump: sum_g lambda_v[g]*(Gv_before[g]+Gv_after[g])/2; separately compare with nodal delta kinetic energy
constraint_work_definition.discrete_constraint_error: ideal prescribed-velocity work minus actual impulse-midpoint work; reported per step, never hidden in heat or tuned away
constraint_work_definition.machine_work_absolute: sum over each end group and guide position/velocity channel of absolute channel work

qualification_scope: 64-step mechanics/guide integration only; contact/interlacing/release and full-process acceptance not claimed
